page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance built on KVM virtualization within the Enhanced instance family. The server provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, utilizing two threads per core. Memory capacity is configured at 32.0 GB, offering an even 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI extensions, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic accelerators. The processor features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache.

Hardware configurations exclude local disk storage, requiring external networked block storage for operating system and file storage needs. Similarly, the instance contains no dedicated hardware graphics processors or accelerators. Network interfaces are configured with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating supplemental network routing or assigned IPs for direct internet accessibility.

Benchmark evaluations place the system solidly within the middle 50 percent across standard compute and memory tiers. Geekbench scores reach 1525.0 in single-core and 5771.0 in multi-core metrics, matching a Passmark CPU score of 11362.25 and a stress-ng multi-core result of 7753.77. In uncached large-block memory operations, read throughput measures 57.95 GB/sec while write speeds reach 41.38 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 7.8 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.47 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

Because it provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio without hardware oversubscription, ecs.g7nex.2xlarge delivers predictable performance efficiency for mixed general enterprise applications. The instance profile is suited for web serving fleets, enterprise backend services, distributed cache layers, database instances backed by network volumes, and general CI/CD workloads.
